asked.item: Reconnect button does nothing, no error

verdict.reason: The help page says Reconnect stops responding with no error when the plan's connected-account limit is reached, and Starter's limit is 20.

steps.text: Reconnecting counts against the same connected-account limit as adding a new account.
If you are at your plan's limit, the Reconnect and Connect buttons stop responding and no error appears.
The Starter plan's limit is 20 connected social accounts.
Disconnect an account you no longer use in Accounts, then reconnect.
To increase your limit, go to Settings > Billing and click View Billing Portal.
